title: identity.user.deleted.v1
description: A user deleted the own account (synthwerk#41). Identity removed the user's identity data in the same transaction. Every service that keeps rows of this user deletes or anonymises them when it gets this fact; a repeat of the event must be harmless. CloudEvents subject: the user sub. The orgid extension stays unset: the fact spans every org of the user. No email, no personal name.

user_sub.description: Subject id (token sub) of the deleted user. Never an email. Services match it against their owner columns.

deleted_orgs.description: Orgs that closed with the account: the user was their only member. Identity deleted them, with their apps and entitlements. Empty when no org closed. A service may delete org-scoped rows of these orgs too.

zitadel_org_id.description: Zitadel org id (token claim urn:zitadel:iam:user:resourceowner:id). Services that scope rows by the token org use this one.
